question: In which of the following years was Shaktikanta Das appointed as the Reserve Bank of India's Governor?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 2018.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shaktikanta Das** was appointed as the Reserve Bank of India's** Governor in 2018.**
 
• Shaktikanta Das** succeeded Urjit Patel **as the** 25th Governor **of RBI.
 
• Prior to his appointment as the Governor, Shaktikanta Das served as the **Economic Affairs Secretary** in the Ministry of Finance.
 
• He has also served as a member of the **15th Finance Commission **and **India's Sherpa to G20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The **Reserve Bank of India **is both the nation's **central bank** and the** regulatory agency** in charge of overseeing the country's banking industry. 
 
• The Indian government's** Ministry of Finance** is the owner of it. 
 
• It is in charge of managing the** Indian rupee's supply**, issuing it, and keeping it in circulation. 
 
• It was founded in **1935, Kolkata.**
